name: Review Next for WooCommerce
author: Nazmul Hosen

sections.description:
Shoppers trust other shoppers. Review Next for WooCommerce replaces the plain WooCommerce review tab with a review experience that shows real customers, real photos and real answers — and gives buyers a reason to leave a review.

Who it is for

  • Small and growing WooCommerce stores whose product pages need more social proof.
  • Stores that sell things people want to see: clothing, beauty, home, electronics, handmade goods.
  • Agencies that want one review plugin that is easy to set up for every client.

Collect better reviews

  • Photo and video reviews — customers add photos (JPG, PNG, GIF) and an MP4 or WebM video to their review.
  • Star rating and review title — a clean form that works on any WooCommerce theme.
  • Who can review — anyone logged in, or only customers with completed orders.
  • Review coupons — reward a verified buyer with a unique WooCommerce coupon (percent or fixed, with expiry, minimum spend and category limits). Coupons only go to customers who actually bought the product.

Show reviews that sell

  • Rating summary — average score and a 5-to-1 star breakdown above the reviews.
  • Verified Purchase badge — added automatically when the reviewer bought the product.
  • Sorting — Most Recent, Highest or Lowest Rating, Most Voted, or With Images/Videos.
  • Helpful votes — shoppers upvote the reviews that helped them.
  • Lightbox — photos open full size in a built-in lightbox.
  • Your colours — set backgrounds, borders, buttons, links and rating icons to match your brand; star or heart rating icons.

Answer questions before they become objections

  • Product Q&A tab — customers ask questions on the product page and your answers stay visible for the next shopper.
  • Store answers — reply to questions right on the product page while logged in as an admin.

Emails that arrive

  • Coupon email to the customer when a reward is earned.
  • Review approved email to the customer when you approve their review.
  • Built-in SMTP settings so plugin emails reach the inbox.

Honest by design

  • Coupons never depend on the star rating, and are given only for verified purchases — in line with the FTC and EU rules on incentivised reviews.
  • Reviews and questions are stored in your own WordPress database. No external service, no account to create.
  • All scripts and styles are bundled with the plugin; nothing loads from third-party CDNs.

Review Next Pro (coming soon)

Review Next Pro is in development: automatic review reminders, review requests by WhatsApp and SMS, and results that show how many orders turn into reviews. Join the waitlist at technoleet.dev.
sections.installation:
1. In wp-admin go to Plugins > Add New, search for Review Next for WooCommerce and click Install Now, then Activate. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Open Review Dashboard in the admin menu to choose who can review, rating icons and colours.
  3. Open Review Dashboard > Coupon Settings to turn on review rewards (set a value above 0).
  4. Visit any product page: the Reviews and Questions tabs replace the default WooCommerce review tab.
sections.faq:
Is it legal to give coupons for reviews?

Rewarding reviews is allowed when the reward does not depend on what the customer writes and the incentive is disclosed. Review Next rewards any verified buyer’s review, never only positive ones. Mention the reward in your review request and on your store.

How is a review marked as Verified Purchase?

Review Next uses WooCommerce’s own check: if the reviewer’s account or email has a paid order for that product, the review gets the badge.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. Review Next uses WooCommerce’s product tabs, so it works with classic and block themes, including Twenty Twenty-Five.

Where are reviews stored?

Reviews are normal WooCommerce product reviews (WordPress comments) with extra fields for photos, video and votes. Questions are stored in a table in your own database. Nothing is sent to an outside service.

What happens to my existing WooCommerce reviews?

They stay where they are and appear in the new review list with their ratings.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Fixed: Fatal error on PHP 7.2–7.4 caused by PHP 8-only syntax.
  • Fixed: Fatal error when approving, spamming or trashing comments on PHP 8.
  • Fixed: Product average rating was reset to 0 after every review submitted through the review form.
  • Fixed: Review coupons were never generated because the user’s review count always came back as 0.
  • Fixed: Reviews submitted through the review form are now marked as “Verified owner” when the customer bought the product.
  • Security: Review coupons are now only rewarded for reviews of products the customer actually purchased (filterable via revnextwoo_coupon_requires_purchase).
  • Security: Removed jQuery 2.2.4 and Lightbox loaded from third-party CDNs; review images now open in the bundled lightbox.
  • Security: Debug logging is now silent unless WP_DEBUG_LOG is enabled, and no longer records customer details or coupon codes.
  • Removed: Placeholder “Your Order Is Complete” email sent on payment completion.
  • Changed: Coupon settings use WooCommerce’s bundled selectWoo instead of select2 from a CDN.

1.0.4

  • Fixed: Broken template path that could throw warnings on the WooCommerce My Account orders page.
  • Fixed: Restored missing Order Count admin templates.
  • New: Introduced Review Next Pro — unlock the full Analytics dashboard, customer location in reviews, visitor counter and AJAX review pagination. Free users now see previews with upgrade links.
  • New: Dependency check for WooCommerce with a friendly admin notice.
  • Enhancement: Admin UI polish and freemium styles.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.

1.0.3

  • New: Added support for Video Reviews! Customers can now upload MP4/WebM videos.
  • New: Implemented Automated Coupon Generation system to reward reviewers.
  • New: Added comprehensive Email Settings with built-in SMTP configuration.
  • New: Added CHANGELOG.md for better version tracking.
  • Enhancement: Improved frontend review display and grid layout.
  • Enhancement: Enhanced “Verified Owner” logic and display.

1.0.2

  • Fixed issue with review display on the frontend
  • Resolved file not found issues
  • Fixed PCP (Product Comparison Page) related issues
  • Addressed prefix and other minor issues
  • Fixed feedback submission issues
  • General bug fixes and improvements

1.0.0

  • Initial release of Review Next for WooCommerce.
  • Feature: Photo reviews, verified badges, and voting system.
